LockMode.Name: Resource locking
LockMode.Hint: How two clients are kept from spending the same character's resources at once. The default writes a short-lived lock on the character. The alternative asks the GC's client instead and writes nothing, so other players' sheets do not redraw on every spend; it needs a GC connected, and must not be used while the GC is signed in from two browsers at once. If the GC's client stops answering, spending falls back to the character lock and asks again a minute later.

RoundStateEffects.Name: Show stances and round effects on tokens
RoundStateEffects.Hint: Adds an Active Effect for each stance, Total Defense, Combat Expertise and similar state a character has, and removes it when the state ends. The effect is a display only.

Text.APlayerWhoHitsACharacter_00l5597: A player who hits a character they do not own, or treats another player's agent, sends the result to the GC's client to apply. When off, each one waits for Allow on a card in the GC's chat. When on, a request that does not fit its card (damage raised above the roll, or a card the player did not post) still waits for Allow.

Text.ApplyRecordedTable52Modifiers_13queou: Apply recorded Table 5.2 modifiers to Initiative Counts when each combat round ends (p.324).

Text.DefaultPlayerAccessToNewCharacters_0fqrj: Default player access to new characters
Text.DialogsOpenWithEveryTheGC_1dbtchy: Dialogs open with every "the GC confirms" box already ticked, so declarations stand unless someone unticks them. Leave off to confirm each one.

Text.MarkEveryCombatantFlatFootedWhen_0s3oiwj: Mark every combatant flat-footed when a combat begins (p.323). It clears by itself as each character’s turn begins or when the character is hit.
Text.OffAClickOpensTheRoll_14gu8c0: Off: a click opens the roll dialog and Shift-click rolls straight away with your last choices. On: the other way round.
Text.OnWhenAnNPCSAttack_0fr7kkw: On: when an NPC's attack is rolled without its dialog against one targeted token, it is resolved against that token's Defense straight away. Use a normal click when you want to spend action dice on the attack first.
Text.OpensTheGCConsoleOrBrings_024as2i: Opens the GC Console, or brings it to the front.
Text.OpensTheSheetOfTheCombatant_0pjrtm7: Opens the sheet of the combatant whose turn it is.
Text.PlayersSeeATargetSDefense_183tbn8: Players see a target's Defense when resolving an attack and can resolve against a recorded target in one click. Turn off to keep NPC Defense hidden; players then pick the target in the resolve dialog and the result still says hit or miss.
Text.PostACardWithItsButton_1xy6doc: Post a card with its button when a burning character's turn begins and, at the end of each round, for every dying character in the fight.
Text.PressTheNextStepOnThe_0arnwu4: Press the next step on the newest card
Text.PressesTheMainButtonOfThe_1p4q8vl: Presses the main button of the newest chat card that has one.

Text.RollWithoutTheDialogByDefault_0k8vsel: Roll without the dialog by default
Text.ShowsANoticeWhenTheCombat_008gok4: Shows a notice when the combat reaches a character you control.
Text.SpendsAGCActionDieOn_1c6f5ol: Spends a GC action die on the card under the pointer, or on the newest result you posted that can still be boosted.
Text.StepsTheActiveCombatBackOne_0owf39n: Steps the active combat back one turn.
Text.TellMeWhenItIsMy_07okadi: Tell me when it is my turn
Text.WhatEveryPlayerCanDoWith_0zdjqua: What every player can do with a newly created agent. Observer lets the table see each other's sheets; the owning player still needs Owner, which the ownership review can set.
Text.WhenAppliedDamageCostsACombatant_1f1i4d1: When applied damage costs a combatant wounds, the matching end-of-round Initiative change is recorded for you.
Text.WhenOffPlayersStillSetTimers_0seh8gb: When off, players still set timers and see the time each has left, but not the time of day.
Text.WhenTheWorldLoadsAndWhen_0n73eup: When the world loads, and when a character is created, renamed or assigned to a player, offer the GC any missing ownership: the default player access above, and Owner for the player the character is assigned to or whose user name appears in its name.
